translations.web: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.
translations.bsb: They also took away the pots, shovels, wick trimmers, dishes, and all the articles of bronze used in the temple service.
translations.kjv: And the pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass wherewith they ministered, took they away.
